Where to Stay in Phetchaburi?
12 Hotels We Actually Reviewed

heroSub: 12 hand-picked Phetchaburi hotels across every budget — from 5-star beachfront resorts in Cha-am to riverside boutique resorts in Kaeng Krachan and an old-town guesthouse from ฿500/night. Covering the main areas: Cha-am, Kaeng Krachan and Phetchaburi Town. From roughly ฿500–5,500/night.
introH2: 🏖️ Why does choosing the right area in Phetchaburi matter so much?
introHtml: Phetchaburi has sea, mountains and an old town, and each area has a completely different vibe. Cha-am is a long sandy beach where Bangkokians drive down for the weekend, with beach resorts from 5-star down to budget hotels, about a 2.5-hour drive from Bangkok. Kaeng Krachan is the mountain-and-reservoir zone on the Phetchaburi River — cool air, quiet, close to nature, with riverside resorts and glamping, about an hour's drive from town. And Phetchaburi Town is the old quarter — Wat Mahathat, Khao Wang palace hill, the famous Phetchaburi sweets and local markets, easy to get around with cheap stays, a handy base before splitting off to Cha-am or Kaeng Krachan. Many people book without checking whether their stay is beachfront, riverside or in town, then lose time driving back and forth over many kilometres. This guide rounds up 12 Phetchaburi hotels we've already reviewed across every tier — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Phetchaburi has no metro, but there's a central railway station (Southern Line) and it's close to Bangkok — about a 2-hour drive to the town, 2.5 hours to Cha-am. The key thing is that the three areas are a fair way apart, so pick the one that fits your plan. Cha-am is in the south of the province, about 40 min from the town, right next to Hua Hin (Prachuap Khiri Khan) for easy onward travel. Kaeng Krachan is to the west, about an hour from the town, a mountain-and-river zone where a car is best. Phetchaburi Town lets you walk Khao Wang, Wat Mahathat and the sweets quarter, with taxis and scooter rentals easy. The areas in this guide: Cha-am — long sandy beach, beach resorts · Kaeng Krachan — mountains, reservoir, Phetchaburi River · Phetchaburi Town — old town, Khao Wang, sweets, easiest access.

entries.name: Devasom Hua Hin Resort
tags: 🏖️ Every room has a sea view · private beachfront
🌅 Great for couples and quiet getaways
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this guide at 9.4 — Devasom is a luxury boutique resort on a private Cha-am beachfront, with a sea view from every room. The draw is a small 23-room resort with charming retro old-Hua-Hin design, very private, ideal for couples and quiet getaways. Real guest reviews praise the private beach, sea views from every room and attentive service, but note that being small, rooms fill fast on holidays. Best for those who want to genuinely sleep on a Cha-am beach in private.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The Seaside Deluxe already has a sea view and lovely atmosphere; move up to a Beachfront Villa only if you want to step straight onto the sand. Book ahead, especially on long weekends — a small resort fills fast.
pros: Highest score in the guide 9.4 — consistent on Booking and Agoda
Sea view from every room · private Cha-am beachfront
Small 23-room resort, old-Hua-Hin design, very private
Attentive service, great for couples and quiet getaways
cons: Small, so rooms fill fast on long weekends — book ahead

entries.name: Veranda Resort & Villas Hua Hin Cha Am
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.0 · 1,966 reviews · most in the guide
tags: 🎨 Beach Chic design on the sand
entries.storyHtml: Veranda is a 5-star beachfront resort in Cha-am under MGallery (Accor), with the most reviews in this guide — over 1,966, a number that tells you it's a stay people pick again and again. The draw is its Beach Chic design on the sand, a 1 MICHELIN Key, and rooms from Deluxe up to private-pool Villas. Real guest reviews praise the design, beach and atmosphere, but note it's a large resort that gets busy on holidays. Best for those who want a full design beach resort in Cha-am.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The beachfront Deluxe Room already has a lovely feel; celebrating or travelling as a group? A Pool Villa with a private pool is better value. It's right next to Hua Hin for easy day trips.

MGallery (Accor) · holds 1 MICHELIN Key
Beach Chic design on the Cha-am sand, distinctive

entries.name: J-House Hotel
entries.addr: 224 Moo 6, Thai Uea-Uthit Soi, Ton Mamuang Rd, Mueang Phetchaburi, Phetchaburi
entries.storyHtml: J-House is the best in-town value in this guide — new, clean rooms from just ฿500 yet a score as high as 9.3 from 403 reviews, numbers that confirm quality beyond the price. The draw is new, quiet rooms with balconies, free bicycles for exploring the town, and a 10-minute drive to Khao Wang. Real guest reviews praise the cleanliness and value, but note it's in the Ton Mamuang area just outside the old quarter, so a car or scooter helps. Best for budget travellers who want a good room in town.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling as a group? The Triple or Family Room splits much cheaper per person. Borrow a free bicycle to ride to the sweets quarter and temples in town.
pros: Best value in the guide ฿500 · high score 9.3 from 403 reviews
New, clean, quiet rooms with balconies

entries.name: Springfield @ Sea Resort & Spa
tags: 🏖️ Private beach on the Cha-am shore
entries.storyHtml: Springfield @ Sea is a boutique beach resort on the Cha-am shore with plenty of reviews — 552, scoring 9.0. The draw is a private beach, a pool with a slide and a kids pool, plus a free Hua Hin shuttle, ideal for families with children. It's part of the Springfield group with a Jack Nicklaus golf course. Real guest reviews praise the private beach and kids facilities, but note it gets fairly busy on holidays. Best for families wanting a full-facility beach resort.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Travelling with kids? Pick a room near the pool. Use the free shuttle for markets and restaurants on the Hua Hin side. Book ahead on long weekends — beachfront rooms fill fast.

entries.name: Asia Cha-am Hotel
entries.storyHtml: Asia Cha-am is a high-rise beachfront hotel in Cha-am whose draw is a 17th-floor sky pool with sea views, from just ฿1,200, scoring 9.1 from 269 reviews. The draw is sea-view rooms, a walk to the beach, and a photogenic sky pool at an accessible price. Real guest reviews praise the pool views and value, but note it's a hotel that's been open a while and some areas show age, so it's worth picking a renovated room. Best for those wanting a sea-view room in Cha-am on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Move up to a Superior Sea View for a balcony over the sea — better value than the Standard. Head up to the 17th-floor sky pool in the evening for the best views.
pros: 17th-floor sky pool with Cha-am sea views, photogenic
From ฿1,200 on the beach — great value

entries.name: Le La Lake Resort and Spa
entries.addr: 201 Moo 8, Song Phi Nong, Kaeng Krachan, Phetchaburi
entries.storyHtml: Le La Lake is a new boutique resort by the Kaeng Krachan reservoir, opened in 2023, scoring 9.0 from 41 reviews. The draw is an infinity pool looking over the lake and mountains, free kayaking to Monkey Island, and a quiet setting close to nature. Real guest reviews praise the lake views and being new and clean, but it's honest to say reviews are still few (41) as it just opened, and it's in Kaeng Krachan where a car is needed. Best for couples and quiet getaways wanting a mountain-and-water feel.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: A couple? The Lake View Suite has the best lake view. A group or family? The 2-bedroom Lake House. Kayak early in the morning when the water is calm for the prettiest views.

Best for couples and campers who love a pretty riverside setting.

entries.name: SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin
entries.storyHtml: SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin is a 5-star design resort on Bang Kao Beach in Cha-am, scoring 8.6 from 144 reviews. The draw is playful, colourful design, a large pool with floating Wibit obstacles and a kids club, ideal for families with children. Real guest reviews praise the design and pool, but it's honest to say the overall score is mid-range for a 5-star and some reviews mention inconsistent service, placing it later in the guide. Best for families who like a design resort with lots of activities rather than quiet luxury.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With kids? Pick the SO Family Kids House with a kids' house/bunk beds. Hit the big pool in the morning before the crowds. Check promotions ahead — 5-star rates swing by period.

entries.storyHtml: Banmai is the cheapest stay in this guide, with dorm beds from just ฿550 yet right by Cha-am Beach, scoring 8.6 from 92 reviews. The draw is a Thai-Western wooden house by the beach with an in-house café, dorm beds with reading lights, plugs and lockers, plus sea-view private rooms. faqTitle: FAQ — Common traveller questions about Phetchaburi hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Phetchaburi?
faq.a: It depends on your travel style. Cha-am suits those who want to sleep by the beach and swim (Devasom, Veranda, Springfield, Asia Cha-am, Golden Beach, SO/ Sofitel, Banmai). Kaeng Krachan suits those who like mountains, rivers and quiet nature (Le La Lake, The Tree Riverside, Nana Resort). Phetchaburi Town suits those who want to walk the old town, Khao Wang and the sweets quarter cheaply (J-House, White Monkey). Cha-am and Kaeng Krachan are a fair way apart, so pick the one that fits your plan.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phetchaburi hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: guesthouses and in-town hotels start around ฿500–1,200 per night; Kaeng Krachan riverside resorts and Cha-am beach hotels run ฿1,400–2,900; 5-star beach resorts start around ฿4,000–5,500+. All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms. On long holidays and in high season, prices can be higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Cha-am or Kaeng Krachan — which should I choose?
faq.a: Cha-am is best if you want the beach and swimming, with beach resorts at every tier, about a 2.5-hour drive from Bangkok and right next to Hua Hin for easy onward travel. Kaeng Krachan is best for a mountain, river and reservoir stay — cooler, quiet and close to nature, about an hour from the town, where a car is best. With a few days you could stay in both.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Phetchaburi hotel?
faq.a: On weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. But on weekends, long holidays, Songkran and New Year, Cha-am is very popular with Bangkokians and beachfront rooms fill fast, so book 3–4 weeks or more ahead, especially for beach resorts and small stays with few rooms.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Phetchaburi, and is it far from Bangkok?
faq.a: Phetchaburi is close to Bangkok — about a 2-hour drive to the town, 2.5 hours to Cha-am. There are Southern Line trains and minivans/coaches from Bangkok. Within the province the three main areas (Cha-am, Kaeng Krachan, the town) are a fair way apart; Kaeng Krachan in particular is easiest with your own car.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest to book a Phetchaburi hotel?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion and period, so it's best to compare all three before booking. Each review page in this guide has price-comparison links — that can save several hundred baht a night.
